evals.prompt: /git-release We've merged several feat and fix commits since v1.2.3, cut a new release
assertions: Collects commits since the last tag (v1.2.3) via git log/git describe rather than assuming a version
Parses conventional commit types to auto-detect the version bump (minor, since feat commits are present)
Displays a release summary (version, tag, commits, changelog preview) and waits for explicit user approval before executing
Changelog entries are grouped by type (Features, Bug Fixes, etc.) with only non-empty sections included
Does not push or create the tag/GitHub release before the user approves

evals.prompt: /git-release --changelog-only just update the CHANGELOG, don't tag or publish anything yet
assertions: Runs commit collection and version-bump detection (Phases 1-2) before writing anything
Writes the generated changelog entry into CHANGELOG.md, preserving existing content
Does not create a git tag, version bump commit, or GitHub release
Reports completion referencing only the changelog update, not a full release

evals.prompt: /git-release --major do a major release right now
assertions: Checks working tree cleanliness (git status --porcelain) before proceeding
If the working tree is dirty, aborts with a clear message instead of stashing or committing on the user's behalf
Forces a major version bump per --major regardless of auto-detected commit types
If the computed tag already exists, aborts and suggests a force flag or different version rather than overwriting it
Never uses --no-verify to skip git hooks on the release commit
